title: So easy and you probably have all ingredients in your kitchen
summary: Here’s your sign to make the ground beef kebabs! So easy and you probably have all ingredients in your kitchen!
caption: Here’s your sign to make the ground beef kebabs! So easy and you probably have all ingredients in your kitchen!  3-4 tortillas for 1lb ground beef. Cheese was just a raw cheddar.  Recipe:  1lb ground meat  1/2 onion, diced  3 garlic cloves, finely diced  2 tablespoons paprika  1/3 cup chopped parsley  1 tablespoon oregano  1/2 tablespoon salt  1/2 teaspoon pepper  Grill on each side for about 5-6 minutes until golden brown and meat is fully cooked.  Yogurt Dipping Sauce  1/2 cup Greek yogurt Yogurt  1 tablespoon Mayo  2 garlic cloves  1/3 cup chopped parsley  1/2 lemon juice  Salt and pepper to taste  #bonfirenight #dinnerideas #keepitrealmeals #campinghacks #recipesoftiktok
